The '''DX-2 massive electrostaff''' was a type of large [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
